Evan: Weekly account health — quick error-lens for AcmeCorp. High-level: 5xx spike 2.3% (↑1.6ppt), timeouts 1.9% (↑0.9ppt), rate-limit responses 0.7% (stable). Top noisy endpoints listed below. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/acme/error-lens :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Priya: Thanks — can you paste the top endpoints and rough % contribution?

Evan: Sure, recent 1h window:
- /v1/generate -> 45% of 5xx (mainly 502/503)
- /v1/stream -> 22% timeouts (client-kept hanging)
- /v1/embeddings -> 18% rate_limit (burst from analytics job)
- /v1/rerank -> 8% 5xx (OOM on p3-dx nodes)
- /v1/health/ping -> 7% other

Marta: Noted. EU region seeing larger timeout tail — median latency +120ms, p95 spiking to 2.8s. Likely KV cache misses after the deploy at 21:06 UTC.

OnboardBot: [deploy-bot] Deploy 2026-03-18T21:05:12Z -> release/rt-optimizations completed on cluster eu-west-1.

Evan: here's a short log snippet of the 502 pattern:
```
upstream_response_time: 3.01, status: 502, host: gpu-rt-12, err: "kv cache miss -> kernel fallback"
```

Priya: Ok — action items?

Marta: 1) Roll back rt-optimizations on eu-west-1 if errors don't drop within 30m. 2) Temporarily route high-throughput embedding jobs to dedicated pool (emb-dedicated-2). 3) Add a retry with exponential backoff for /v1/stream on client SDKs.

Evan: I'll open a ticket and add the rollback playbook. Can we confirm someone to execute routing change if needed?

Priya: I can trigger the routing switch and coordinate with infra. I'll post updates here.

Marta: I'll watch the error rates and post p95/5xx in 15m.

Evan: Thanks team. Will follow up in the weekly CS check-in doc. :thumbsup:
